g.text: FB: the VCF's output -> FEEDBACK pot (B100K) -> 1 uF -> 22k -> +-0.6 V diode clamp -> the VCF's CV_CUTOFF (1 V/oct): the output modulates its own cutoff, at most about +-0.55 octave. Fully down (CCW): none.

g.text: JP1 (bridged 1-2) grounds the VCF's IN_VCF; cut it and bridge 2-3 for the old route, the wiper into IN_VCF (it latches above about 90 %).
